# PortAI

> AI financial news bias checker and professional portfolio tracker for retail investors. Real-time tracking of 7,000+ stocks, ETFs and crypto, paired with AI bias detection, misinformation checks and trust scoring across major financial outlets.

PortAI helps retail investors cut through biased financial reporting. The platform combines multi-asset watchlists (stocks, ETFs, crypto) with candlestick charts, price alerts, AI-powered fact-checking, trust scoring of news sources and a live market heatmap. "Sentry" is PortAI's in-app AI analyst. Plus and Pro tiers unlock deeper bias reports and higher AI usage limits.

PortAI is an informational and analytical tool. It does not provide personalized financial advice.

- [Home](https://portai-invest.com/): Product overview, live analyzer demo, pricing, FAQ.

- [Market news](https://portai-invest.com/news): Financial news feed with per-source trust scores.
- [Seeking Alpha vs Motley Fool](https://portai-invest.com/compare/seeking-alpha-vs-motley-fool): Bias and conflict-of-interest comparison.
- [Best stock advisor services](https://portai-invest.com/compare/best-stock-advisor-services): Evaluation of major advisory subscriptions.
- [How to detect pump-and-dump schemes](https://portai-invest.com/blog/how-to-detect-pump-and-dump-schemes): Red flags and a verification checklist.
- [Privacy Policy](https://portai-invest.com/privacy-policy): How we collect and process user data.
- [Terms of Service](https://portai-invest.com/terms-of-service): Terms governing use of the platform.
- [Data & Compliance](https://portai-invest.com/data-compliance): GDPR, data retention and security practices.
- [IP Policy](https://portai-invest.com/ip-policy): Intellectual property and content usage policy.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://portai-invest.com/accessibility): WCAG 2.1 AA commitment and feedback channel.
